title: Build SQS and ordered structural models
action: For each composition (Li₂VO₂F, Li₂V₀.₅Ti₀.₅O₂F, Li₂V₀.₅Fe₀.₅O₂F), generate one or more Special Quasirandom Structures (SQS) representing the disordered rock-salt phase, and construct a set of candidate ordered prototype structures derived from α-NaFeO₂ and γ-LiFeO₂ types.
description: Use SQS generation tools (e.g., ATAT mcsqs or pymatgen) to create disordered supercells that match the target compositions. Build ordered cells by substituting elements into the reference prototype lattices.

title: DFT total-energy calculations
action: Perform DFT structural relaxations and total-energy calculations for all structures generated in step 1 using Quantum ESPRESSO with PAW pseudopotentials, PBE functional, Hubbard U corrections (U(V)=3.25, U(Ti)=3.50, U(Fe)=4.30), a plane-wave cutoff of 600 eV, k-point spacing ≤ 0.04 Å⁻¹, and force convergence below 0.02 eV/Å.
description: Run DFT calculations for all SQS and ordered models, ensuring full relaxation. Extract the final total energy per formula unit for each relaxed structure.

title: Compute ordering propensity ΔE
action: For each composition, identify the lowest total energy among the fully relaxed ordered prototypes, then compute ΔE = E_SQS - min(E_ordered) and convert to meV/atom. Write the three ΔE values as a JSON file.
description: Compute the energy difference between the disordered SQS and the most stable ordered structure for each composition. Output a JSON object with keys corresponding to the three compounds and float values in meV/atom.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'Li2VO2F', 'Li2V0.5Ti0.5O2F', 'Li2V0.5Fe0.5O2F'; each value is a float representing ΔE in meV/atom.
